content: a reversal's end-to-end ID must be exactly `RV` + the original E2E ID. For this payment that's `RVACME5F2A9C0D11E7`.
the bank rejects the same end-to-end ID twice on one clearing date (NB-417 Duplicate end-to-end reference … for clearing date 2026-03-12).
no suffix allowed: using a different ID like `RVACME5F2A9C0D11E702` results in NB-422 because it isn't exactly `RV` + the original ID.
Assistant has not written `/tmp/nordbank-cert/test-file.json` because no file meeting all requirements can pass.
"Two partial reversals of the same payment can't be accepted on the same clearing date."
